newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris estimates cut.

text.p: -- PaineWebber said analyst Emanuel Goldman cut his first quarter and full-year 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates on Philip Morris Cos Inc, citing the strength of the U.S. dollar versus the Japanese yen and the German mark.
-- Said currency translation is dampening Philip Morris's international food and tobacco earnings.

-- Goldman reduced his first quarter view to $2.19 from $2.23, a report from the brokerage said. He lowered his full-year 1997 estimate to $8.90 from $9.06. He cut his 1998 forecast to $10.51 from $10.67.
